text:
Alex: Heads up — planning to enable mirage-v2 in the catalog during the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window tonight. Rolling 10% -> 50% if metrics stable. Need ops ack and final fallback ordering.
Jamie: ack from eng-releases side. Confirming fallback ordering and pin behavior?
Alex: Yes. Plan is to pin mirage-v2 for 24h for canary traffic, fallback ladder below. Config snippet:
```
catalog.enable("mirage-v2", {
  "pin": true,
  "rollout_pct": 10,
  "fallback_order": ["mirage-quant-v2","mirage-7b-v1","mirage-4b"],
  "drain_window": "15m"
})
```
Alex: DeployBot will attempt the staged enable, then verify probe dashboards.
DeployBot: preflight checks passed: infra capacity ok, model artifacts verified, deployment policy -> staged_percent=10.
Sara: What's our rollback trigger? Latency > +40ms p50, error rate > 0.5% and regressed eval on safety testset.
Michael: I'll run a quick smoke eval and push the perf graphs to the rollout dashboard. Will monitor embeddings latency too.
Jamie: Also can we set the fallback to prefer quant variant first? QA noted quality parity but 30% cost savings.
Alex: That's reflected in fallback_order above (quant first). Adding an explicit pin TTL: 24h. After TTL, will auto-unpin and drain.
Sara: Ops runbook pointers — if rollback needed:
- run `deploybot rollback 3367890000` 
- set catalog.pin(false) manually if rollback tool fails
- open incident channel #incidents
Michael: I'll create a Grafana alert: mirage-v2 p50 latency > baseline+40ms (5m) -> pager.
DeployBot: scheduled enable at 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z (thread 3367890000). Will post progress updates.
Jamie: any doc updates for release notes? Short blurb + quant fallback note.
Alex: I'll add release note and link to eval results after canary. tagging @Sara for runbook confirm.
Sara: Runbook confirmed. Ops ready. :thumbsup: 
Jamie: ack :thumbsup:
Alex: launching preflight run 30m before window. ping if any last-minute holds.
